name: Club Carlson Rewards Visa Signature
notes: Historical Club Carlson record. Official U.S. Bank servicing material checked 2026-10-20 lists Radisson Rewards Visa, but does not establish this Club Carlson generation, its withdrawal date, or a conversion to another card. The existing discontinued status and the remaining financial fields are retained as unverified historical data. Exact lifecycle and successor remain unknown; a product-specific official archive or conversion notice is still required. Historical artwork provenance (checked 2026-10-21): the retained 2016-05-08 archive of the official U.S. Bank product page for this card shows the image 222x139-ccsig.png with alt text "Club Carlson(SM) Rewards Visa Signature® Card". The official Club Carlson Premier Visa Signature page uses the identical asset, so the two records share it as an issuer-confirmed shared plastic (SHARED_ART_FAMILIES). The linked image resolves to a 2015-09-06 archive capture of the U.S. Bank-hosted asset and was visually inspected as the black Club Carlson Visa Signature card. It is a low-resolution 222x139 historical image; it is not evidence of lifecycle or the financial fields, which were not reverified in this artwork-only update. Annual fee correction (checked 2026-10-21): the record previously stored a $0 fee, which conflicted with the official product page's renewal bonus. The retained 2016-05-08 archive of U.S. Bank's official Club Carlson(SM) Rewards Visa Signature® Card Terms and Conditions, linked as Pricing & Terms from that product page, lists "Annual Membership Fee" $50 and no introductory annual fee, so annual_fee is $50 with first_year $50 as of those 2016 terms; fee history in other years was not checked.
